summary: Selected HeliBoard security, typing and stability improvements.

changes.title: Privacy and stability
changes.detail: Restrict clipboard and settings actions while locked; ignore null text and empty popup layouts.

changes.title: Faster typing and better learning
changes.detail: Remove delete-swipe delay, preserve manual glide shift, handle Unicode casing, and exclude unwanted trailing punctuation and forced capitalization from history.

changes.title: Clipboard efficiency
changes.detail: Skip clipboard suggestion preparation while the suggestion strip is unavailable.
